objective:
A small Python key-value store that keeps entries in memory and expires them.

It should provide: get, set and delete with an optional per-entry time to live;
expiry evaluated lazily on read and also by an explicit sweep; a bounded size
with least-recently-used eviction when the bound is reached; snapshot and
restore of the live entries to and from a JSON file; and statistics reporting
hits, misses and evictions.

Pure standard library. Time must be injectable so expiry is testable without
sleeping.
